run_mkdoc_extract_docs: run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into a C docstring header file
run_mkdoc_with_includes: run mkdoc.py with -I include paths to extract documentation from C++ headers with custom include directories
process_comment_convert_doxygen: process_comment converts Doxygen tags like \param and \return into Markdown formatted docstrings
sanitize_name_for_docstring: sanitize_name transforms C++ identifiers including operators into valid Python docstring variable names
extract_ast_nodes: extract recursively walks a Clang AST to collect documentation from classes, functions, enums, and methods
